name: 브라우저
description: 웹 페이지를 여는 브라우저 카드. 사이드바에 문서 구조, 네트워크, 탭, 방문 기록을 보여 준다.

home.label: 홈 주소
home.description: 새 브라우저 카드가 처음 여는 http 또는 https 주소다. 비우면 주소 입력 안내로 시작한다.

status.name: browser.location
status.description: The state of the document region: address, title, loading and its progress from 0 to 1, whether history can go back or forward, the last load error or null, the document scroll position in CSS pixels, and the address of the link under the pointer or an empty string.

status.name: browser.address.text
status.description: The text the address field shows and whether the field has focus.

status.name: browser.history
status.description: The value of the 히스토리 section, which the section view draws: one list of the session history entries of the document region from the oldest, each with the title or the address as its label and bound to browser.history.go with its position, the current entry selected, or the empty list.

status.name: browser.elements
status.description: The value of the DOM section, which the section view draws: one tree of the elements of the document in document order, each with tag, id and class as its label nested by depth, a status line for a snapshot cut above 500 nodes, and a status line for the elements below the 16-level limit of a tree, or the empty tree before the first snapshot and after a reset of the document.

status.name: browser.requests
status.description: The value of the 네트워크 section, which the section view draws: one static list of the requests that the document recorded, each with type and address as its label and the duration in milliseconds as its detail, and a status line with the count the request log dropped, or the empty list before the first entries and after a reset of the document.

status.name: browser.tabs
status.description: The value of the 탭 section, which the section view draws: one list of the browser tabs of the card that holds the surface, each with its title or label as its label and bound to browser.tab.select with its tab, the active tab selected, or the empty list without such a card. The page follows core.grid through runtime.status.watch.

status.name: browser.section
status.description: The state of a section view: pending until core reports the section, empty when the section follows no surface of this plugin, or followed when the section draws the status of its section on the followed surface.

commands.name: browser.history.go
commands.description: Loads the session history entry at a position; returns whether a load started, false for the current entry.

commands.name: browser.address.select
commands.description: Focuses the address field and selects its complete value for replacement.

commands.name: browser.navigate
commands.description: Opens an http or https address in the document region.

commands.name: browser.back
commands.description: Goes back in the document history and returns whether there was an entry to go to.

commands.name: browser.forward
commands.description: Goes forward in the document history and returns whether there was an entry to go to.

commands.name: browser.reload
commands.description: Reloads the document and returns whether a document was loaded.

commands.name: browser.stop
commands.description: Stops any load in progress and returns true.

commands.name: browser.tab.select
commands.description: Selects a browser tab of the card that holds the 탭 section through core.tab.select, with the operation of the request.

element.name: browser.reload
element.description: The button that reloads the document, or stops loading while it loads.

element.name: browser.document
element.description: The element the document region occupies.

element.name: browser.empty
element.description: The element shown in place of the document while the address is empty; a click focuses the address field.

element.name: browser.section.row
element.description: A row of a section list or tree: an item, a node of a tree, or the branch that holds its children.

element.name: browser.section.item
element.description: The button of a section item that runs its command on the followed surface.

element.name: browser.section.empty
element.description: The text that a section shows in place of its value when the value has no entries, or when the section follows no surface.

element.name: browser.section.status
element.description: A status line of a section value, such as the count of the entries that a snapshot cut.
